caseName: Ross ex rel. Dunham v. Lantz
caseNameFull: Ross, by His Next Friend, Dunham v. Lantz, Commissioner, Connecticut Department of Correction

opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. Application for stay of execution of sentence of death, presented to Justice Ginsburg, and by her referred to the Court, denied. Motion for leave to proceed on 8V2- by 11-inch paper granted. Certiorari denied.
